resources.string: A gentle heads-up when your period is likely to arrive.
Small, kind suggestions for wherever you are in your cycle.
Sometime around today or tomorrow — how are you feeling?
The days before your period can bring shifts in mood, sleep or energy. Noticing them now makes the pattern easier to read later.
For reflection and entertainment — not medical guidance.
Bloom is not a medical device. Predictions are estimates, not certainty.
